overall_notes: The paper describes a shared task on feedback comment generation for language learners. It's clearly an NLG evaluation paper focusing on generating explanatory feedback comments. The extraction was generally good but included some items that were mentioned in passing rather than being core to the paper's evaluation. The paper uses both automatic (BLEU) and human evaluation, but no LLM-as-judge (which wasn't common in 2021).
